name-01.output: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?
name-01.direct: Lin Xiao, why did you come so early today?
name-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'来得这么早'在英文口语中常说 come in this early 或 come so early，语气是日常问候，无需调整。
name-01.free: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

context-01.output: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.
context-01.direct: Don't worry, I've already memorized it thoroughly.
context-01.reflect: 直译准确自然。'背熟了'指把内容背得滚瓜烂熟，英文用 memorized it 或 know it by heart 都地道；'别担心'用 Don't worry 自然。
context-01.free: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

slang-01.output: That move was insane—I'm literally losing it.
slang-01.direct: This wave of operation is too showy, I directly split open.
slang-01.reflect: 直译完全不通：'这波操作'是网络用语指'这一手/这波操作'，'秀'指厉害/骚气，'裂开'是网络梗表示崩溃/震惊。需要用地道英文网络表达。
slang-01.free: That move was insane—I'm literally losing it.

idiom-01.direct: This of yours is simply drawing legs on a snake.
idiom-01.reflect: 直译保留了成语字面，但英文读者不懂这个典故；英语里有对应习语 gild the lily，表示多此一举、画蛇添足，更地道。

short-01.reflect: 单字应答，语气随意，英文用 Yeah 最自然。

corpus-01.output: Teacher, I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.
corpus-01.direct: Teacher, I really did write my homework, but it was eaten by the dog.
corpus-01.reflect: 直译准确，但英文里“dog ate my homework”是众所周知的借口梗，用“the dog ate my homework”更地道，能传达出学生找借口的语气。
corpus-01.free: Teacher, I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.

corpus-02.output: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lines!
corpus-02.direct: That tilt of the head was sneaking a peek at the words!
corpus-02.reflect: 直译准确传达了意思，但英文里'偷看词'更自然的说法是'peeking at the lyrics/script'，需根据场景判断；这里没有明确是歌词还是台词，用'words'或'lines'较通用。'偏头那一下'用'that head tilt'更口语化。
corpus-02.free: That head tilt was totally you sneaking a peek at the lines!

corpus-03.output: Nah, not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.
corpus-03.direct: Not dating, keeping a sense of mystery is pretty good.
corpus-03.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象" (not dating/not in a relationship). "保持神秘感挺好的" means keeping the mystery is nice. The tone is casual and a bit playful/deflecting. English should sound casual and natural.
corpus-03.free: Nah, not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.

corpus-04.reflect: 直译生硬，不符合英语口语。原文是表达惊讶'这么突然的吗'，英语自然说法是'That was so sudden'或'So sudden?'。

corpus-05.output: It's just—hahaha, that's so random. Who even gets this question?
corpus-05.direct: It's just hahaha too abstract, who understands this question
corpus-05.reflect: “太抽象了”是网络用语，指事情离谱、难以理解，直译 abstract 在英文里也能表达“莫名其妙/离谱”的意思，但需要加语气；“谁懂啊”是网络流行语，表示共鸣式吐槽，英文对应 who gets it / I can't even。
corpus-05.free: It's just—hahaha, that's so random. Who even gets this question?

corpus-06.output: Seems like it's true—I even came across some leaked footage from his concert.
corpus-06.direct: Seems like it's true, I even scrolled to leaked videos of his concert.
corpus-06.reflect: "刷到" is internet slang for coming across something while scrolling; "路透" means leaked/spoiler footage from a concert. "好像是真的" responds to something, so "Seems like it's true" works. Need natural phrasing for scrolling across videos.
corpus-06.free: Seems like it's true—I even came across some leaked footage from his concert.

corpus-07.output: Which class meeting? How come nobody told me?
corpus-07.direct: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?
corpus-07.reflect: “班会”指班级会议，“我怎么没听着”是口语化的反问，表达没被通知到的疑惑/不满。直译基本准确，但“hear about it”更自然，语气保留反问。
corpus-07.free: Which class meeting? How come nobody told me?

corpus-08.output: Besides, his honest, down-to-earth vibe makes him so approachable. You're not losing out here—with that face of yours, you might even score a free meal.
corpus-08.direct: Besides, his honest and simple temperament is so down-to-earth and approachable. You're not losing out this time—maybe you can even mooch a meal with that face.
corpus-08.reflect: “憨厚老实的气质”指人看起来老实可靠、接地气；“亲民”指平易近人、讨人喜欢；“你这波不亏”是网络口语，意为这次不亏、划算；“蹭顿饭”是口语，指白吃一顿、蹭饭。直译基本准确，但“蹭顿饭”用 mooch a meal 更地道，“靠这张脸”可译为 with that face of yours 更自然。
corpus-08.free: Besides, his honest, down-to-earth vibe makes him so approachable. You're not losing out here—with that face of yours, you might even score a free meal.

corpus-09.output: Should we throw this souvenir away?
corpus-09.direct: Should this souvenir be thrown away?
corpus-09.reflect: 直译准确自然，'要不要'表达的是征询意见，英文用'Should we...'更口语化，符合日常对话语气。
corpus-09.free: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-10.output: That idea of yours is pretty out there.
corpus-10.direct: Your idea is also abstract enough.
corpus-10.reflect: "抽象" is Chinese internet slang meaning absurd/ridiculous/weird, not literally "abstract"; the tone is teasing/mocking. "够抽象的" = "pretty out there / ridiculous".
corpus-10.free: That idea of yours is pretty out there.

corpus-11.output: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap when I'm back in China.
corpus-11.direct: Fine, wait until I return to the country to deal with these toxic chicken soups.
corpus-11.reflect: "毒鸡汤" is internet slang for motivational/inspirational content that's actually misleading or harmful—not literal toxic soup. "回国" means return to China. "行" here is a casual agreement/acknowledgment. Need to render "毒鸡汤" naturally in English, e.g. "toxic motivational posts" or "toxic feel-good nonsense."
corpus-11.free: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap when I'm back in China.

corpus-12.output: That short? Hit a creative block, did you?
corpus-12.direct: So short, did you hit a creative bottleneck?
corpus-12.reflect: 直译准确，但"创作瓶颈"在口语英文里更常说"creative block"或"writer's block"，"bottleneck"偏工程术语，不够自然。语气是调侃式反问，用"Did you hit..."或"Are you having..."都自然。
corpus-12.free: That short? Hit a creative block, did you?

corpus-14.output: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — who wins?
corpus-14.direct: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — who comes out on top?
corpus-14.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'方案vs同事的PPT'是口语化对比标题，'谁更胜一筹'是反问式比较，英文用'who wins'或'which comes out on top'更自然。'方案'指proposal/plan，'PPT'保留为PPT符合职场语境。
corpus-14.free: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — who wins?

corpus-15.output: Just look at that smug, know-it-all expression—you can tell something's off. That kind of deadpan nonsense is comedy gold.
corpus-15.direct: Just look at that expression of his pretending to be profound and you know there's something fishy—this kind of deadpan nonsense has the best comedic effect.
corpus-15.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"故作高深"和"一本正经的胡说八道"是口语化表达，英文里"deadpan nonsense"能传达一本正经胡说八道的幽默感，"有猫腻"用"something fishy"地道。整体流畅自然。
corpus-15.free: Just look at that smug, know-it-all expression—you can tell something's off. That kind of deadpan nonsense is comedy gold.

corpus-16.output: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on Moments every day.
corpus-16.direct: Why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on your Moments every day.
corpus-16.reflect: “我去”是感叹词，表惊讶/恍然大悟，不是“我去某地”；“不早说”是“怎么不早说”，带点埋怨；“朋友圈”是微信朋友圈，英文常说 Moments 或 WeChat Moments；“晒”是晒图/发图，用 post 更自然。整体语气是恍然大悟带点调侃。
corpus-16.free: Oh man, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on Moments every day.

corpus-17.output: Nah, not dating. These days love comes with a price tag.
corpus-17.direct: No deal, these days love is all clearly priced.
corpus-17.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象" (not going to date/be in a relationship), not "no deal" in a business sense. "明码标价" means openly priced/tagged with a price, implying love has become transactional. Need to capture the casual rejection tone and the cynical observation.
corpus-17.free: Nah, not dating. These days love comes with a price tag.

corpus-18.output: Not looking for a relationship. Go play by yourself.
corpus-18.direct: No dating, go play by yourself.
corpus-18.reflect: “不处”是网络用语，指不处对象/不谈恋爱；“自己玩去”是打发人的口语，带点不耐烦。直译生硬，需要口语化。
corpus-18.free: Not looking for a relationship. Go play by yourself.

corpus-19.output: Look, the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.
corpus-19.direct: Look, the lottery ticket I bought has the winning numbers exactly the same as what you said yesterday.
corpus-19.reflect: 直译准确，但英文口语中更自然的结构是把'中奖号码'和'你昨天说的'直接对比，用'are exactly the same as'更顺；'你看'在此是引起注意，用'Look'合适。
corpus-19.free: Look, the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.

corpus-20.output: Hakimi north-south mung beans—I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.
corpus-20.direct: Hakimi north-south mung beans, I'm holding it in at my workstation until I get internal injuries.
corpus-20.reflect: "哈基米南北绿豆" is a nonsense meme phrase (from a viral cat video song), not meant literally; "憋出内伤" means suppressing laughter/emotion so hard it hurts inside. Need to keep the meme feel and convey stifled laughter.
corpus-20.free: Hakimi north-south mung beans—I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.

corpus-21.output: Ran into this dude on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.
corpus-21.direct: On the subway I ran into a big bro who kept talking to himself in anime lines the whole way.
corpus-21.reflect: “大哥” here is a casual term for an older/macho stranger, best rendered as “guy” or “dude” rather than literal “big brother”; “动漫台词” means anime quotes/lines; “全程” = the whole ride. Tone is casual storytelling, so keep it colloquial.
corpus-21.free: Ran into this dude on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-22.output: Stayed up late last night watching your livestream—laughed so hard my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.direct: Last night I stayed up late watching your livestream and laughed until my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.reflect: 直译准确自然，'laughed until my stomach hurt' 是英语中表达笑到肚子疼的地道说法，语气轻松口语化，符合原句的调侃氛围。
corpus-22.free: Stayed up late last night watching your livestream—laughed so hard my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.output: Was in such a rush to leave that I grabbed a rag instead of a towel and brought it to the office.
corpus-23.direct: In a hurry to go out, I directly took the rag to the company as a towel.
corpus-23.reflect: 直译基本准确，但 'directly took...as a towel' 略显生硬，'in a hurry to go out' 可更口语化。原文是自嘲式吐槽，语气应轻松自然。
corpus-23.free: Was in such a rush to leave that I grabbed a rag instead of a towel and brought it to the office.

corpus-24.output: Not dating. That gossip is too much to handle.
corpus-24.direct: Not dating, the melon is too big to bite through.
corpus-24.reflect: “不处”是网络用语，指不处对象/不谈恋爱；“瓜”是网络梗，指八卦/瓜；“啃不动”指瓜太大吃不下，比喻八卦信息量太大消化不了。直译“melon”会让英文观众误解为真的西瓜，需要意译出“八卦”的含义。
corpus-24.free: Not dating. That gossip is too much to handle.

corpus-27.output: Isn't that how it should be?
corpus-27.direct: Isn't this what it should be?
corpus-27.reflect: 直译生硬，不符合英语口语习惯。这句话是反问，表达"本来就该这样"的意思，英语里常用 Isn't that how it should be? 或 That's how it should be, isn't it? 来传达这种理所当然的语气。
corpus-27.free: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-28.output: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.direct: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.reflect: 直译准确自然，'保洁阿姨'译为 cleaning lady 符合英语口语习惯，'老板'用 the boss 即可。
corpus-28.free: The boss is marrying the cleaning lady.

corpus-29.output: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better suited for heavier people trying to lose fat?
corpus-29.direct: Treadmill, elliptical, and spin bike—which is more suitable for high-body-weight fat-loss people?
corpus-29.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'大体重减脂人群'直译生硬，英文更常说'people with a high body weight who want to lose fat'或'heavier people trying to lose fat'；'动感单车'指spin bike/indoor cycling bike，'更适合'用better suited更自然。
corpus-29.free: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better suited for heavier people trying to lose fat?

corpus-31.output: Oh my god, I can't—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, everyone's got at least one embarrassing period-pad-buying story, right?
corpus-31.direct: Oh my, I can't take it, this kind of experience can make me laugh for a year, who among everyone doesn't have a bit of a social-death story about buying sanitary pads!
corpus-31.reflect: 直译生硬：'我不行了'是笑到受不了，'笑一年'是夸张说法，'社死'是网络梗指尴尬到社会性死亡，'谁还没点'是反问表示大家都有。需要用地道口语表达。
corpus-31.free: Oh my god, I can't—I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, everyone's got at least one embarrassing period-pad-buying story, right?

corpus-32.output: I'm already running a fever—please, aunties, give me a break.
corpus-32.direct: I'm already running a fever, please let me go, aunties.
corpus-32.reflect: "大妈们" refers to the middle-aged women (often a noisy square-dancing or nagging crowd); "放过我" means "spare me / let me off the hook." Literal "let me go" sounds like being physically held; "give me a break" or "spare me" captures the exasperated, pleading tone better.
corpus-32.free: I'm already running a fever—please, aunties, give me a break.

corpus-33.output: Watch Gen Z chat in their weird internet slang
corpus-33.direct: Watch post-00s chat in Martian language
corpus-33.reflect: "火星文" is Chinese internet slang for the stylized, hard-to-read text (leet-like symbols, rare characters) that young netizens used; "Martian language" would confuse English viewers, so better to render it as the actual phenomenon—cryptic/weird internet slang.
corpus-33.free: Watch Gen Z chat in their weird internet slang

corpus-34.output: I keep getting interrupted by messages at work and can't focus on my tasks. Any tips for improving efficiency?
corpus-34.direct: At work I'm always interrupted by all kinds of messages, hard to focus on doing things, what methods are there to improve efficiency?
corpus-34.reflect: 直译准确，但英文表达略显生硬。'总被各种消息打断'可更自然地表达为'constantly getting interrupted by messages'，'难以专注做事'用'can't focus on my work'更地道，'有什么提高效率的方法'用'Any tips for improving efficiency?'更符合口语提问习惯。
corpus-34.free: I keep getting interrupted by messages at work and can't focus on my tasks. Any tips for improving efficiency?

corpus-38.output: I was scrolling through videos and saw this huge jianbing guozi made by a Shandong auntie at her stall, and it got me wondering—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in all of China?
corpus-38.direct: Scrolling through videos, I saw a giant jianbing guozi made by a Shandong auntie, and suddenly I got curious: is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the whole country?
corpus-38.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'auntie'在英语里指亲戚，这里指摊煎饼的大妈，应改为'auntie'的街头称呼或直接说'a woman from Shandong'；'jianbing guozi'保留拼音可接受，但英文观众可能不熟，可加简短说明；'the whole country'自然。整体语气是好奇、口语化，需保持轻松。
corpus-38.free: I was scrolling through videos and saw this huge jianbing guozi made by a Shandong auntie at her stall, and it got me wondering—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in all of China?

corpus-39.output: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.
corpus-39.direct: Douban's high score of 9.4 also proves its quality.
corpus-39.reflect: 直译准确自然，'豆瓣9.4的高分'在英文语境中可保留 Douban 并说明是评分，'也证明了它的品质'直译即可，语气平实陈述，无需改动。
corpus-39.free: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.

corpus-40.output: I can't even—this happiness came out of nowhere.
corpus-40.direct: I can't take it, happiness came too suddenly.
corpus-40.reflect: 直译准确，但"I can't take it"在英文里更像受不了负面事物，这里表达的是被幸福冲击到招架不住，用"I can't even"或"I can't handle this"更贴合网络口语语气；"幸福来得太突然"是常见网络感叹，英文对应表达是"this is too much happiness all at once"或"happiness hit me out of nowhere"。
corpus-40.free: I can't even—this happiness came out of nowhere.

corpus-41.output: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.
corpus-41.direct: Others: white-browed tiger with upward-slanting eyes. Me: Qiaolezi ice cream.
corpus-41.reflect: “吊睛白额虎”是《水浒传》里对猛虎的经典称呼，指眼睛上吊、额头有白斑的老虎，这里与“巧乐兹雪糕”形成反差梗——别人是凶猛老虎，我是甜甜的雪糕。直译保留字面即可，但“吊睛白额虎”英文观众不熟，需稍作解释性处理，同时保留对比结构。
corpus-41.free: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.

corpus-42.output: Hahaha I can't even, netizens these days are just too clever
corpus-42.direct: Hahaha I can't anymore, this batch of netizens is really too talented
corpus-42.reflect: "我不行了" here means laughing too hard to handle it, not literally giving up; "这届网友" is internet slang meaning "netizens these days/this generation of netizens"; "太有才了" means hilariously clever/witty. Need natural colloquial English.
corpus-42.free: Hahaha I can't even, netizens these days are just too clever

corpus-44.output: I'm done. I've worked so much overtime I'm completely numb.
corpus-44.direct: I can't anymore, working overtime until I'm numb all over.
corpus-44.reflect: “我不行了”是口语化的崩溃/撑不住，“人都麻了”是网络流行语，指累到麻木、没感觉了，直译“numb”能传达但稍显生硬；英文口语里“I'm done”“I'm dead”更自然，“numb”可保留以体现麻木感。
corpus-44.free: I'm done. I've worked so much overtime I'm completely numb.

corpus-45.free: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team's called, uh, Xiao Chao Team, right? I remember all of it!

corpus-47.output: Can you stop dragging me into playing games?
corpus-47.direct: Can you stop dragging me to play games?
corpus-47.reflect: 直译准确，但'dragging me to play games'稍显生硬，'拉着我'在此是'缠着、拉着一起'的意思，英文更自然说'stop dragging me into games'或'stop pulling me into games'。语气是抱怨，需保留。
corpus-47.free: Can you stop dragging me into playing games?

corpus-48.output: I can't even—this is way too cute!
corpus-48.direct: I can't take it anymore, this is way too cute!

corpus-48.free: I can't even—this is way too cute!

corpus-49.free: I can't do this anymore. I know everything—I've grinded so hard I'm going bald.

ctx-01.output: Don't worry, I've already memorized it.

ctx-01.free: Don't worry, I've already memorized it.

ctx-02.direct: She said she won't come back for dinner tonight.
